data.name: BranchHelp
data.value: Goes on by its way true when the condition holds, else by its way false.

data.name: SetVariableHelp
data.value: Played at once, once each time the state is entered.

data.name: GetVariableHelp
data.value: Gives the variable's value to the node its wire reaches.

data.name: ActivityHelp
data.value: Plays the activity whole, with its settings, until it is done.

data.name: PodsAtLeastHelp
data.value: What the character carries, against what it may carry.

data.name: LifeAtLeastHelp
data.value: The character's life as the server last said it, against its most.

data.name: JobLevelAtLeastHelp
data.value: A profession's level; a profession the character lacks does not hold.

data.name: JobLevelAtLeastExample
data.value: Lumberjack at least level 40: the ash trees are behind.

data.name: KamasAtLeastHelp
data.value: The kamas the character carries, not its bank's.

data.name: ItemsAtLeastHelp
data.value: The items of the inventory, counted together.

data.name: ItemsAtLeastExample
data.value: At least 100 of Ash Wood: go and craft.

data.name: InSubAreaHelp
data.value: The sub-area the server says the character is in.

data.name: InAreaHelp
data.value: Any sub-area of the areas, by the pack.

data.name: LastFightHelp
data.value: The last fight the bot saw end; none before the first.

data.name: RunLongerThanHelp
data.value: Since the profile was started on the character.

data.name: FlagOnHelp
data.value: Reads a flag, such as a variable's.

data.name: FlagOffHelp
data.value: Not: a condition that does not hold.

data.name: NumberAtLeastHelp
data.value: Compares a number, such as a variable's, with a bound.

data.name: NumberAtLeastExample
data.value: Fights won at least 10: go and bank.

data.name: MapChangedHelp
data.value: The character arrived on another map.

data.name: FightBeganHelp
data.value: The character entered a fight, its own or one it was attacked in.

data.name: FightOverHelp
data.value: The fight's end, as the server said it.

data.name: FightOverExample
data.value: When a fight ends lost: set lost to on, then a state heals.

data.name: LevelGainedHelp
data.value: The character's level, on the same connection.

data.name: JobLevelGainedHelp
data.value: A profession's level, on the same connection.

data.name: ItemReceivedHelp
data.value: More of an item than there was, on the same connection.

data.name: Connected
data.value: When a connection plays the character

data.name: ConnectedHelp
data.value: The client connected, or connected again.

data.name: DisconnectedHelp
data.value: The client closed, or lost the server.

data.name: WaitHelp
data.value: Played whole, and again if an interruption cut it.

data.name: NoteHelp
data.value: Writes in the bot's journal; played at once.

data.name: NoteExample
data.value: Note "Bank full": it shows in the journal.

data.name: PauseHelp
data.value: As the player's hand does: the bot waits until it is resumed.

data.name: StopHelp
data.value: The run ends, done, once its step is over.

data.name: RouteHarvestHelp
data.value: Harvests the resources on the map, in their order, then goes on.

data.name: RouteFightHelp
data.value: Fights the groups of the map that the filter lets through, then goes on. No monster chosen, every group.

data.name: RouteFightRule
data.value: The fewest monsters of a group cannot be more than the most.

data.name: RouteDoorHelp
data.value: Uses the door whose element stands on the cell, then goes on.

data.name: RouteExitHelp
data.value: Forces the exit: by the cell, when one is chosen, else by the side of the map.

data.name: RouteZaapHelp
data.value: Teleports to the zaap nearest the next step.

data.name: RouteBagHelp
data.value: Enters the haven bag from the map.

data.name: RouteFollowHelp
data.value: Goes through the route of the project: its maps in order, as its course says, and what it does on each. A loop goes on until another state takes over.

data.name: RouteNotPlayed
data.value: The route holds the action {0}, which the host does not know: it does not start.

data.name: RouteUnreachableFails
data.value: Step {0} of the route, map {1}, is out of reach: the route fails.

data.name: RouteUnreachablePassed
data.value: Step {0} of the route, map {1}, is out of reach: passed.

data.name: RouteNothingReachable
data.value: No step of the route can be reached from here: the route fails.

data.name: RouteMissing
data.value: The route {0} is not in the project.

data.name: SequencePlayHelp
data.value: Plays a list of steps of the project as one step: its steps in order, once, as many times as this step repeats. Its own repeat is left to this step.

data.name: SequenceMissing
data.value: The sequence {0} is not in the project, or is no list of steps: the run ends.

data.name: SequenceCycle
data.value: The sequence {0} plays itself, directly or through others: the run ends.

data.name: RouteNpcHelp
data.value: Talks to the NPC of the map and gives it the replies, the first to its first question, and so on. No reply chosen, the dialog is opened and left.

data.name: RouteActionFailed
data.value: The action {0} of the route could not be played on map {1} ({2}): the route fails.

data.name: RouteZaapNoNext
data.value: The route goes nowhere after this step: no zaap to take.

data.name: RouteZaapNone
data.value: No zaap saves a map change on the way to map {0}: none is taken.
